initial_description: This block contains helper functions for processing text. The 'clean_text' function removes extra whitespace and normalizes the text, while the 'tokenize' function converts the text to lowercase and splits it into tokens. These functions are essential for preparing the documents before they are stored in the vector store.
deep_description:
This block contains helper functions for processing text. The 'clean_text' function removes extra whitespace and normalizes the text, while the 'tokenize' function converts the text to lowercase and splits it into tokens. These functions are essential for preparing the documents before they are stored in the vector store.

Components:
- clean_text_function: Removes extra whitespace and normalizes the input text.
- clean_text_docstring: Docstring explaining the purpose of the clean_text function.
- clean_text_return_statement: Returns the cleaned text by removing extra whitespace.
- tokenize_function: Converts the input text to lowercase and splits it into tokens.
- tokenize_docstring: Docstring explaining the purpose of the tokenize function.
- tokenize_return_statement: Returns the tokenized version of the input text.
